2609.15982.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
2609.15982.paper_summary: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. Retrieval pipelines move the selection out of the context, but also out of the agent's capability. We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two linear maps suffice to read it out with no skill text in the context. Gavel (Glance And Verdict from a frozen LLM) reads it in two steps. A glance projects the task's and each skill's mid-layer states through the two maps, the only parameters trained, and scores the full library against compact per-skill banks that one forward pass builds at installation. A verdict then resumes the shortlisted skills' forward passes and reads the model's own likelihood and yes/no judgment, fused with the glance as a product of experts. Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories. On Qwen3-32B it outperforms progressive disclosure and retrieve-and-rerank pipelines that add 1.2B to 16B external parameters, by up to 13.4 points on written tasks and up to 21.9 when the need for a skill arises mid-rollout. Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness the same 32B triggers the correct skill on Skill-Use more often than far larger frontier models running in Codex.
2609.15982.paper_summary_zh: 技能使 LLM 代理超越其參數知識，而它們所承諾的增益取決於選擇正確的技能。<lb/> 部署的 harness 通過將每個技能的元數據預加載到上下文中來進行路由，這會分散代理的注意力並限制庫的大小。<lb/> 檢索管道將選擇移出上下文，但也超出了代理的能力。<lb/> 我們顯示凍結的代理 LLM 已經在其自己的前向傳播中攜帶路由信號，並且兩個線性映射足以在上下文中沒有技能文本的情況下讀取它。<lb/> Gavel（來自凍結 LLM 的 Glance And Verdict）分兩步讀取它。<lb/> 一個 glance 通過這兩個映射投影任務和每個技能的中層狀態，這是唯一訓練的參數，並對整個庫進行評分，與安裝時一個前向傳播構建的緊湊每技能銀行進行比較。<lb/> 然後，判決恢復入圍技能的前向傳播，並讀取模型自己的可能性和是/否判斷，與 glance 融合，作為專家的產物。<lb/> 一經訓練，Gavel 零樣本轉移到三個公共基準和 SkillTraj，我們新的 372 條模擬代理軌跡的基準。<lb/> 在 Qwen3-32B 上，它在書面任務上比添加 12 億到 160 億外部參數的漸進披露和檢索-重新排序管道高出多達 13.4 分，而在需要技能的情況下高出多達 21.9 分。<lb/> 路由準確性隨著骨幹的改進而提高，在 bash-agent harness 中，相同的 32B 在 Skill-Use 上比運行在 Codex 中的更大前沿模型更頻繁地觸發正確的技能。
